title: AOI-SSL: Self-Supervised Framework for Efficient Segmentation of Wire-bonded Semiconductors In Optical Inspection
mechanism: MAE pretraining in a 7k-image industrial domain (beats DINO and iBOT); hybrid conv-ViT keeps thin wires; patch-level kNN retrieval over labelled patch embeddings adapts to a new device family with tens of images.
adaptation: (b) first: kNN retrieval head on house encoder features with a memory from a few labelled half-cut cells (T3b few-shot track), fused with house logits for E1. (a) MAE on a hybrid conv-ViT only if a ConvNeXt MIM arm passes.
min_experiment: Arm: house PF ensemble + retrieval head with T3b memory. Baseline: house PF ensemble. Metric: E1 crack recall at matched precision. Kill if < +0.02.
evidence: R: FasterViT-0 MAE 60.3 mIoU vs ResNet18 U-Net++ ImageNet 52.4 (architectures differ); wire IoU 66.7 vs 43.0 for ViT-Tiny; retrieval 71.5 vs 47.5 mIoU on a single device family with a 42-image memory.

alt_notes.adaptation: (a) MAE on a hybrid conv-ViT on the pool, PF; (b) kNN patch-retrieval head on house encoder features with a memory from a few labelled half-cut cells, fused with house logits, as an E1 few-shot track.
alt_notes.min_experiment: (b) kNN head vs house PF ensemble on E1 crack recall at matched precision; kill if < +0.02. ~2 GPU-h.
